checkpoint.title: The rival on Route 22, at the road's east end

events.why: the precondition for the Route 22 rival: the lead at least Lv49, pokeguy's Blastoise here (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md route22-rival); 17.04's Giovanni needs Lv50
out of the Mart and west out of Viridian City onto Route 22, along row 5 to (34, 5), a tile short of the rival's trigger column (33, 4..6)
onto (33, 5): Route22_EventScript_LateRivalTriggerMid (VAR_MAP_SCENE_ROUTE22 is 3 once Giovanni is beaten, 17.04) puts the rival at (25, 5) and walks him seven tiles east to face the player

the rival (TRAINER_RIVAL_ROUTE22_LATE_BULBASAUR for a player who took Squirtle): Pidgeot Lv47, Rhyhorn Lv45, Gyarados Lv45, Growlithe Lv45, Alakazam Lv47, Venusaur Lv53; fought by pokeguy's policy C2 (goal-based-setup: Sp. Atk +2 and Accuracy +2 by X Specials and X Accuracies, X Speed until faster, the doc's route22-rival row); foe_threats are the rows PokemonSimulation's player-strategy planning_risk() gives for each foe leading against the entry state (153/153, the doc's route22-rival case: the 80th percentile of the foe's move choice, its mean, its worst case, and its worst normal hit), one row per foe: Venusaur's worst case (crit Razor Leaf) is 156 of 153 HP, Rhyhorn's 126. Then he walks off and the player stays facing west

checkpoint: Starts in the Viridian Mart where 19.01a ends, with the potions bought. The rival's trigger needs VAR_MAP_SCENE_ROUTE22 at 3, which Giovanni's defeat sets (ViridianCity_Gym scripts), so the row can not be reached by hand before the Earth Badge. PokeGuy has this fight at 1:46 (docs/battles/pokeguy-conditions.md, route22-rival) at 153/153 HP; the Center heal in 17.04b is that entry.
Ends on Route 22 at (33, 5) facing west, saved there (the battle saves after it): 19.02 walks on to the north gate (8, 5) and Route 23.
